verdict.rationale: Moss documents upserting additional documents and deleting documents or indexes later (moss-docs-22). It also describes freshness mechanisms: local indexing during real-time sessions that later syncs to the cloud (moss-docs-5), staying fresh via zero-downtime hot-swaps (moss-docs-6), disk caches that reload when cloud data changes (moss-docs-24), and serving a stale snapshot when the cloud is unreachable (moss-docs-25). However, the evidence never states how quickly upserts and deletes become visible in search, nor what consistency model applies between local and cloud copies. Missing for 10: documented update-to-search visibility latency, an explicit consistency model for continuous upserts and deletes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of freshness under continuous writes.
